title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
他像是楞了一下，然后低头看着我笑起来：“你真的喝多了。”我觉得成年人，想睡觉就直说，不要在这里搞这些小贴心小暧昧，又不谈恋爱，弄得这么覆杂实在没必要。在我看来，最好的相处方式就是脱衣服上床打炮，然后穿衣服下床出门，其他的都是多余。性又不可耻，可耻的是明明是见色起意，还非要恶心巴拉地套上爱情的名义，真的非常婊。我不耐烦地扯着傅斯澄的领带把他拉进隔间里，扣上门，他比我高半个多头，我微微仰视着他：“我清醒得很，不然怎么可能会不知道你脑子里在想什么？”傅斯澄突然被我扯到隔间里，怔了一怔，然后他看着我，眼睛里是我从很多玩咖身上见到过的暧昧和欲望，像是沙漏一样，一点点溢出来，慢慢堆积。我心想这人果然也装不了多久，趁早干吧，干完滚蛋，要不是看他长得好看，我才懒得先问出那句“做不做”。傅斯澄慢慢地把手覆在我揪着他的领带的手上，嘴边带着笑，说了一句让我耳目一新的话：“我喝酒了，硬不起来，我带你回家好不好？”真有种。我实在很没耐心跟他在这里欲擒故纵，挣开他的手，直接往他身下摸。然后我冷笑了一声：“我以为你说硬不起来是阳痿的借口呢，那请问你这反应是怎么回事？”他动了动喉结，然后抓住我的手腕，说：“你喝多了，我带你回家。”妈的，这是我头一回主动约炮，也是头一回被拒绝。对我有兴趣又不愿意跟我做，那想干什么，搞对食么？谈论人生哲学？寻找宇宙真谛？我是真生气了，心里烦得要死，甩开他的手打开了门，低声说了一句：“那你以后最好别烦我。”我猜这人是个神经病，明明表现出兴趣，等我开口的时候又找理由拒绝，装得一副很慎重的样子，也不知道是不是靠这种演技行骗的，反正我没耐心耗了，爱做不做。走着走着，身上突然被盖了一件衣服，我转过头，看见傅斯澄不知道什么时候已经跟上来了，正把他的棉服往我身上披。我停下脚步，非常不耐烦地想把那件衣服拉下去，他却伸手按住我的肩膀，推着我往外走，一边说：“外面冷，你今天穿得太少了，等会儿会着凉的。”我烦死这种人了，这种背臺词一样的关心话真的很让我讨厌。那天晚上他送我到了楼下就走了，临走时还试图帮我理理被风吹乱的头发，被我冷冷偏头躲开。他丝毫不恼怒，眼里带着笑意，在月光下清亮生辉，然后他朝我挥挥手告别。我进电梯的时候才发现忘了把外套还给他。心里更烦了。拿起手机给他发微信：你的外套忘带走了。想了想又删掉了，这话听着总觉得是我邀请他回来拿外套然后暗示他上楼坐坐似的，未免显得太恶心了些。

于是我说：外套忘拿了，下次还你。发出去以后才发现这好像根本就是变相地邀约下次再见。我很焦躁，我觉得我今晚可能是真的喝了太多的酒了。傅斯澄回：好，你有空就联系我，我过来拿，你早点休息。他的外套上传来那种不让我讨厌的香味，我更焦躁了。平平淡淡地过了几天，骆非突然发微信问我：你和斯澄上次一起走了以后有没有干什么？我：没有。骆非：他这段时间都不出来玩了，也不知道怎么了，安分得不行。我：怎么，他以前很不安分？于是，骆非花了个把小时跟我详细描述了傅斯澄是如何声色犬马夜夜笙歌纵情欢场的。骆非这人嘴巴靠不住，他的话大多只能信百分之五十，剩下的百分之五十全是他与生俱来的基因里带着的瞎说本事。但是就连骆非这张嘴都能在埋汰傅斯澄的时候说：“不过斯澄也不是乱玩的，很多时候都是为了生意和社交，他在床上这方面还蛮讲究的，虽然换人勤，但起码不搞群p，炮友也都是差不多门当户对的人。”可见傅斯澄应该不属于滥交那拨。不过这年头，不搞群p都能变成一个人不乱玩的标准了，也不知道是这群富二代底线太低还是社会风气太差。我想起傅斯澄那张看起来温柔无害的笑脸，越想越觉得应该劝他去演戏，明明是个浪荡公子哥，装得还挺正儿八经。有些人不能想，一想他就会给你发微信。我跟骆非刚结束聊天，傅斯澄就给我发消息：今天有空吗？一起吃个晚饭吧。我最讨厌跟人单独吃晚饭，于是说：不吃晚饭，来咖啡厅拿你的衣服。傅斯澄：好哒：）看着就窝火，真他妈想揍他。作者有话说：梁暖：遇见傅斯澄以后，焦躁成了我的人生主旋律。早点更！晚上回去安安心心写虎牙腺体！

He seemed stunned for a moment, then looked down at me and smiled: "You really drank too much." I think adults, if you want to sleep, just say so, don't engage in these small intimate affairs here, and don't fall in love. It's really unnecessary to make it so complicated.In my opinion, the best way to get along is to take off your clothes and go to bed to have sex, then get dressed and get out of bed. Everything else is superfluous.Sex is not shameful, but what is shameful is that it is clearly motivated by sex, but it still has to be disgustingly disguised in the name of love. It is really a bitch.I impatiently pulled Fu Sicheng into the cubicle by his tie and locked the door. He was more than half a head taller than me. I looked up at him slightly: "I'm very awake, otherwise how could I not know what's going on in your mind?" Fu Sicheng was suddenly pulled into the cubicle by me. He was startled for a moment, and then he looked at me. His eyes were full of ambiguity and desire that I had seen from many gamers. They were like hourglasses, overflowing little by little and slowly accumulating.I thought to myself that this guy really couldn't keep up the pretense for long, so he should do it as soon as possible and then get out. If it weren't for his good looks, I wouldn't have bothered to ask "should I do it or not" first.Fu Sicheng slowly put his hand on my hand that was holding his tie. With a smile on his lips, he said something refreshing to me: "I've been drinking and can't get hard. Can I take you home?" That's really cool.I really didn't have the patience to play hard to get with him, so I broke away from his hand and touched him directly.Then I sneered: "I thought your inability to get hard was an excuse for impotence, so what's the reason for your reaction?" He moved his Adam's apple, then grabbed my wrist and said, "You drank too much, I'll take you home." Damn, this was the first time I took the initiative to hook up with someone, and the first time I was rejected.If you are interested in me but don’t want to do it with me, what do you want to do? Is it the right thing to do?Talk about philosophy of life?Looking for the true meaning of the universe?I was really angry and annoyed to death, so I threw his hand away, opened the door, and whispered, "Then you'd better not bother me in the future." I guessed that this man was a psychopath. He showed interest clearly, but when I opened my mouth, he found a reason to refuse, pretending to be very cautious. I don't know if he relied on this kind of acting to deceive me. Anyway, I ran out of patience, and I couldn't do it as much as I wanted.As I was walking, a piece of clothing suddenly covered me. I turned my head and saw Fu Sicheng had caught up with me and was putting his cotton coat on me.I stopped and impatiently tried to pull the dress off, but he put his hand on my shoulders and pushed me out, saying, "It's cold outside. You're wearing too little today. You'll catch a cold later." I'm so annoyed by this kind of person. This kind of caring words like reciting lines really annoy me.That night, he walked me downstairs and left. Before leaving, he tried to help me straighten my hair that was messed up by the wind, but I turned my head coldly to avoid him.He was not angry at all, with a smile in his eyes that shone brightly in the moonlight, and then he waved goodbye to me.When I entered the elevator, I realized that I forgot to return his coat.I felt even more annoyed.Picked up the phone and sent him a WeChat message: You forgot to take your coat.I thought about it and deleted it. It always sounded like I was inviting him back to get his coat and then suggesting that he go upstairs and sit down. It seemed too disgusting.

So I said: I forgot to take my coat, I will give it back to you next time.Only after I sent it did I realize that it seemed like a disguised invitation to see you again next time.I'm very anxious and I think I may have had too much wine tonight.Fu Sicheng replied: Okay, contact me when you have time, I will come and get it, and you can go to bed early.There was a scent that I didn't hate coming from his coat, which made me even more anxious.A few days passed normally, and Luo Fei suddenly sent me a WeChat message asking me: Have you and Sicheng done anything since you left together last time?I don't.Luo Fei: He hasn't come out to play during this period. He doesn't know what's wrong. He can't be peaceful anymore.Me: Why, he used to be very restless?So, Luo Fei spent an hour describing to me in detail how Fu Sicheng was having fun every night.Luo Fei is an unreliable person. Most of his words can only be believed 50% of the time. The remaining 50% is all nonsense inherent in his genes.But even Luo Fei was able to say when he wanted to eliminate Fu Sicheng: "But Sicheng is not a promiscuous person. Most of the time he does it for business and socializing. He is quite particular about bed. Although he changes people frequently, at least he doesn't engage in group sex, and his sex partners are all pretty well matched." It can be seen that Fu Sicheng is not a promiscuous person.But these days, not engaging in group sex has become the standard for a person not to mess around. I don’t know if it’s because the bottom line of this group of rich second-generation people is too low or because the social atmosphere is too bad.I thought of Fu Sicheng's seemingly gentle and harmless smile, and the more I thought about it, the more I felt that I should persuade him to act. He was obviously a swinger, but he pretended to be quite serious.Some people can't think about it, and they will send you WeChat messages as soon as they think about it.As soon as Luo Fei and I finished chatting, Fu Sicheng sent me a message: Are you free today?Let's have dinner together.I hate having dinner alone with others, so I said: If you don’t want to have dinner, come to the cafe to get your clothes.Fu Sicheng: Okay:) I get angry just looking at him, I really want to beat him.The author has something to say: Liang Nuan: After meeting Fu Sicheng, anxiety became the main theme of my life.Update soon!Go home in the evening and write about tiger tooth glands with peace of mind!
